title: Hello world index route
description:
Build the Remix page at `/` so that it shows a single heading with the text `Hello, World!`. ### Rules & clarifications - The heading is an `

` element and its text is exactly `Hello, World!`, with the capital letters, the comma and the exclamation mark. - The page has no other heading. - Write the code in the `Index` component in `app/routes/_index.tsx`. The root layout in `app/root.tsx` is read-only. - The tests check the content of the page, not its styling: no CSS is needed. - The rendered HTML has this structure: ```html

Hello, World!

``` ### Example Open the page → the heading `Hello, World!` is shown.
